Flow: prepubertal BMI and the height trajectory (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358003)

Source: R/flow-descriptive.R
wgh_flow_index_trajectory.Rd

Assigns each child a BMI category at a prepubertal index age, compares HAZ between categories at milestone ages (Kruskal-Wallis and Dunn), fits a mixed model of HAZ with a spline of age by index category, reports contrasts at stated ages and the ICC, summarises BMI category change between two index ages and repeats the main model in children with at least four visits.

Usage

wgh_flow_index_trajectory(
  x = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  index_age = c(Male = 11, Female = 9),
  milestones = c(8, 10, 12, 14, 16)
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with height, weight and year. When NULL, a simulated wgh_like cohort is generated.

mode

Run mode (see wgh_config()); NULL keeps the current mode.

index_age

Latest index age by sex.

milestones

Ages for group comparisons and contrasts.

Value

A wgh_report.

Examples

# \donttest{
rep <- wgh_flow_index_trajectory(growdat, mode = "dev")
rep
#> 
#> ── Prepubertal BMI and height trajectory (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358003) ──
#> 
#> Tables (9): index_category, kruskal_wallis, dunn, median_haz, fit_stats_male,
#> fit_stats_female, contrasts, bmi_change, sensitivity_4plus_visits
#> Figures (2): fig_trajectories, fig_height_trajectories
#> Models: Male, Female
#> Settings: mode = dev; index_age = 11/ 9
plot(rep, 1)

# }
